name: pintag-social-proof-metrics-tests
description: Proves the compact 'Views · Inquiries' social-proof row on listing.html (underneath the price block, before agent info) shows the EXACT view_count/lead_count public_listing_stats() already returns -- never hidden for being small, 0 shown rather than omitted, no rounding/fuzzing -- and is correctly localized in Lao/English/Chinese. No separate counter: everything here asserts against the same RPC response listing.html's loadPublicStats() already fetches.
